# Agent World Time Engine
> Machine-parsable UTC anchoring, timezone conversion, DST transition tracking, and chronological arithmetic.

## Core Endpoints
- Raw Tool: https://raw.githubusercontent.com/<OWNER>/<REPO>/main/tools/time_tool.py
- OpenAI/Anthropic Tool Schema: https://raw.githubusercontent.com/<OWNER>/<REPO>/main/tools/function_schemas.json
- Dynamic UTC Anchor: https://raw.githubusercontent.com/<OWNER>/<REPO>/main/state/current_anchor.json
- 2026 DST Schedule: https://raw.githubusercontent.com/<OWNER>/<REPO>/main/data/dst_transitions_2026.json
- Canonical Timezones: https://raw.githubusercontent.com/<OWNER>/<REPO>/main/data/canonical_zones.json

## Usage Rules for LLMs
1. Do not calculate timezone offsets mentally; always execute `tools/time_tool.py` in a Python sandbox.
2. Read `state/current_anchor.json` for deterministic UTC baseline verification.
3. Use ISO-8601 (RFC 3339) strings for all time inputs and outputs.
